remarks: This is the one you've been waiting for. Perfectly blending timeless architecture with exceptional in-town convenience, this stunning five-bedroom Colonial, designed by renowned local architect Neil Hauck, is nestled on one of the area's most coveted streets.  The thoughtfully designed floor plan is ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. At the heart of the home is a spectacular gourmet kitchen that flows seamlessly into the inviting family room, complete with a fireplace and dramatic oversized windows that flood the space with natural light.  Step outside to your own private retreat, where a beautifully manicured lawn, mature landscaping, and a spacious stone patio create the perfect setting for outdoor dining, entertaining, or simply relaxing.  The first floor offers a private guest bedroom, while the second level features four additional bedrooms, including a serene primary suite. A finished third floor provides the perfect flex space for a playroom, home office, media room, or workout area.  Combining exceptional craftsmanship, an unbeatable location, and effortless in-town living, this is a rare opportunity to own a truly special home. Don't miss it!
